info.title: IntentBook API
info.description: Public book API. Dry-run does not call execute_intents. Writes that move funds require a signed intent and the live gate.

get.summary: Best price across the book, 1Click, and Rhea

post.summary: Build an unsigned order. Optional standard: nep413 (default), raw_ed25519 for implicit accounts. EVM accounts always get erc191.
Place a signed order. Named NEAR accounts must sign with a full-access key or a key registered on intents.near.
Build the cancel message the order owner signs. Body: id, account, optional standard.
Cancel with { signed }: the owner's signature over the cancel-preview message. Unsigned cancels are refused.
Build an empty intent that reuses the order nonce, for an on-chain nonce burn.
Simulate the signed nonce burn. Broadcast only in live mode.
Simulate one signed ft_withdraw. Broadcast only in live mode and under the 50 USDC cap.
Build the registration message the account owner signs. Body: account, url.
Register an HMAC webhook with { account, url, signed }. Production accepts only https URLs on public hosts.

get.summary: Server-sent book, trade, and ticker events
WebSocket upgrade on the same HTTP port. Query pair=BTC-USDC.
